Boruch Hashem
Blessed is He

# Chesed Maximal Improvement Wave

> The Awtsmoos renews every hidden seam before the seam can know its name; Awtsmoos.com pours possibility without limit, then verification teaches every vessel how to carry flame.

## Everything still worth challenging

1. Verify every newly split lifecycle/demo/cache test file parses and stays under 120 lines.
2. Re-run the new focused regression universe after the final test splits, not before.
3. Re-run the existing universal facade/compiler/constraint/default-compiler universe beside it.
4. Re-run the recursive lifecycle import graph and package self-reference from package scope.
5. Re-run the structural gate after all source/test/doc changes, including CSS/HTML ceilings.
6. Re-run the full package test universe and compare only new reds against the independently proven baseline.
7. Start a fresh local static server after focused tests are green.
8. Launch a new cache-busted Chrome target rather than reusing earlier page state.
9. Verify unknown scenario query falls back to the first scenario and rewrites the canonical query.
10. Verify ArrowLeft and ArrowRight wrap and focus correctly.
11. Verify Home selects/focuses the first scenario and End selects/focuses the last.
12. Verify Ctrl/Meta/Alt/Shift modified navigation keys do nothing.
13. Verify keys dispatched from input/textarea/select/contenteditable do nothing.
14. Verify rapid scenario selection cannot let an old async generation overwrite the latest generation.
15. Verify lifecycle workspace aria-busy true during work and false when complete.
16. Verify polite status announcement reports completion.
17. Verify root data state moves loading/compiling -> ready.
18. Verify nine summary cards exist and include local compile time, primitive count, pipeline support counts.
19. Verify every scenario still produces exactly one SVG artifact and 15 pipeline stages.
20. Verify unresolved constraint counts remain truthful for each of the five authored worlds.
21. Verify compile-again exposes miss -> hit reuse in public status.
22. Verify 320px CSS viewport has no page-level horizontal overflow.
23. Verify 390px CSS viewport has no page-level horizontal overflow.
24. Verify very long budget/hash/compiler/solver text remains contained at both widths.
25. Verify every network resource is same-origin.
26. Verify no runtime exceptions, console errors, or severe browser logs.
27. Measure current v3 demo JS/core module count and compare to the lifecycle static graph.
28. Re-run deterministic cache microbenchmark after cache identity tests settle.
29. Verify failed compilation leaves cache statistics honest.
30. Verify environment-dependent solver bypass produces no accidental cache entry.
31. Verify compiler version change invalidates a shared cache.
32. Verify compiler support-state change invalidates a shared cache.
33. Verify solver version change invalidates a shared cache.
34. Verify explanation remains executor-free on the lifecycle facade.
35. Verify malformed JSON/wrapper/seed/request precedence parity on lifecycle facade.
36. Verify package subpath import itself remains direct to the lightweight module.
37. Inspect package export ordering and accidental duplicate keys.
38. Inspect public universal index for accidental world imports through the lightweight subpath.
39. Inspect all new demo renderers for innerHTML/eval/network regressions.
40. Inspect all new error surfaces for host paths/secrets leaking to public text.
41. Inspect all touched source/test files for cramped one-line functions or hidden space indentation.
42. Inspect all touched docs for claims stronger than measured evidence.
43. Create a current evidence ledger entry with exact test/browser job ids.
44. Create PLANNED_VS_ACTUAL_DELTA from plans 18-23 and actual files/results.
45. Search for TODO/FIXME/XXX/placeholder markers in mission-owned files.
46. Search for accidental dead/unreferenced new modules.
47. Search for duplicate demo responsibility after the latest split.
48. Search for any public route or package documentation still showing only full createAwtsmoos.
49. Search for stale version-2 demo assumptions in tests/docs.
50. Search for stale 6-summary-card assumptions after v3 summary expansion.
51. Build an exact mission file manifest before staging.
52. Classify every mission-adjacent dirty file as required, unrelated, or uncertain.
53. Refresh HEAD, origin/main, branch, and remote just before integration.
54. Fetch origin and calculate divergence at that exact moment.
55. Create a clean integration worktree from fresh origin/main because primary is dirty.
56. Copy/cherry-pick only the mission tranche into the clean worktree.
57. Run critical focused tests in the clean integration worktree.
58. Run package self-reference/import graph in the clean integration worktree.
59. Serve the demo from the integration worktree and browser-smoke it before commit/push if practical.
60. Inspect full staged diff in integration worktree.
61. Commit one coherent universal-lifecycle/demo tranche.
62. Push exact commit SHA to origin/main only after fresh fetch/fast-forward safety proof.
63. Verify remote main SHA via ls-remote.
64. Re-read bhRelease prepare contract immediately before deployment.
65. Run prepare phase only from the clean exact integration worktree.
66. Run activate phase only with the exact pushed SHA.
67. Verify production worktree HEAD and origin/main equal the intended SHA.
68. Verify canonical server activation receipt/status.
69. Fresh-browser public https://awtsmoos.com/apps/universal-procedural/.
70. Repeat the local browser contract publicly: five scenarios, cache hit, 15 stages, navigation, narrow widths, no severe logs.
71. Verify public resources are same-origin and lifecycle-module graph remains light.
72. Verify public HTML advertises version 3 and lifecycle composition.
73. Verify public server revision/authority evidence identifies intended release SHA when infrastructure exposes it.
74. Update API/migration/performance docs with final v3 browser measurements.
75. Update EVIDENCE_LEDGER with release/public proof.
76. Update REMAINING_WORK after each gate; do not empty it merely because code is green.
77. Update NEXT_ACTION after each gate; execute it while safe.
78. Re-read every mission-owned file after integration and compare planned vs actual one last time.
79. Run embarrassment test: what would a user notice immediately as unfinished?
80. Run takeover test: what would a new developer do first?
81. Run hidden-dependency search again after integration because origin/main moved.
82. Run hidden-test search again after integration because fresh upstream may add relevant coverage.
83. Re-run architecture/import graph if upstream changes touch universal API infrastructure.
84. Preserve historical baseline reds rather than silently rewriting unrelated work.
85. Clean local static server/browser targets only after evidence is copied into durable ledger.
86. Remove temporary clean worktrees only after remote/public proof is preserved.
87. Ensure docs do not promise typed dependency scheduling that does not exist.
88. Ensure docs do not promise subgraph incremental cache that does not exist.
89. Ensure demo never implies SVG is canonical semantic output.
90. Ensure lifecycle/full factories continue sharing one Awtsmoos implementation, not forked logic.
